description: A project's server-log uploads and their parse status — the Log File Analyzer / Bot Analytics feature. Each row is `{ id, fileName, sizeBytes, status, lineCount, parsedLineCount, skippedLineCount, errorMessage, createdAt, completedAt }`. `status` is one of queued/parsing/completed/failed. lineCount/parsedLineCount/skippedLineCount are null until parsing completes — an absent count is not zero. FREE (no credits). Pair with log_analyzer_upload to add a log, log_analyzer_daily_summary / log_analyzer_top_paths for the report.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: log_analyzer_list_uploads
